nodes.label: Phase 1 Slice 3 — The LOD Ladder
nodes.rationale: Every ingested mesh gets three glTF rungs alongside its thumbnail, stored by hash and served over an authorized blob route, so Phase 3's viewer has something to open. No new dependencies — not for clustering, not for glTF.

nodes.label: LOD Ladder
nodes.rationale: L2 at measure.rs's existing 1e-4 mm quantisation is lossless de-duplication; L1 and L0 at bbox/96 and bbox/32 are the lossy rungs. A mesh coarser than L0's own grid clusters to itself, and content addressing then makes its three identical rungs one blob with three references.

nodes.label: Vertex Clustering
nodes.rationale: One indexing function run at three grid sizes produces the whole ladder, rather than three algorithms or a clustering dependency. Collapsed cells are dropped.

nodes.label: write_glb
nodes.rationale: Hand-written uncompressed glTF 2.0 binary. DATA.md's meshopt choice stands but is not implemented here: its decoder is Phase 3's viewer and its Rust binding wraps C, which would put a C toolchain in the worker image. kernel_version carries glb-1 so Phase 3 can find these and re-encode.

nodes.label: Kernel Takes Bytes
nodes.rationale: The Kernel trait starts taking bytes rather than a path because the shipped code's refusal to re-read the file is right — the bytes are already in hand from hashing, and re-reading is both slower and a second chance for the file to change underneath.

nodes.label: KernelOutput
nodes.rationale: MeshOutput is deleted and KernelOutput becomes the one output type, with Entity added for analytic geometry. Its shape had been Phase 0a follow-up item 2, open since Phase 0a; Entity ships uninhabited, so no measurement snaps to analytic geometry yet.

nodes.label: GET /api/blob/{blake3}
nodes.rationale: Reachability is the authorization check: content addressing is not authorization, so the route verifies the hash is reachable from the caller's tenant rather than trusting knowledge of the hash. A malformed hash gets the same 404 as an unknown one, because a 400 would separate well-formed-but-absent from malformed — a smaller version of the oracle the reachability check exists to close.

nodes.label: derivative_storage_is_exclusive
nodes.rationale: A derivative is stored inline or by hash, never both and never neither. Both columns had been nullable and independent since migration 0002, so a row with neither was legal — and a row with neither is a derivative that cannot be served. derivative.blake3 also becomes a foreign key to blob. Verified against a migrated database rather than assumed, because a migration that fails on real data fails at deploy rather than in CI.

nodes.label: parse_obj
nodes.rationale: Shares stl.rs's finish gate rather than duplicating the validity checks, so both parsers reject the same malformed shapes for the same reasons. Its fixture is a real part with a plausible number, not cube.obj with three vertices.
